# Alexandr Gribcov

> Senior Full Stack Engineer, Frontend Lead & Team Lead with 12+ years of production experience (6+ years fully remote). Specializes in building and scaling web applications, AI integration for business workflows, and leading engineering teams.

## Core Summary
- **Roles:** Senior Full Stack Engineer, Frontend Lead, Team Lead, Technical Consultant.
- **Experience:** 12+ years total, 6+ years remote across international teams (EU / UK / US timezones).
- **Availability:** Open to selective B2B contract engagements, architecture advisory & senior IC / tech lead / frontend lead roles.
- **Work Model:** Remote-first, async-friendly, independent end-to-end delivery.

## Key Track Record & Impact
- **WorkFusion:** Tech Lead. Engineered automated support & onboarding workflows that reduced client onboarding and support turnaround time from 3 weeks to 30 minutes. Built core design system from scratch (WCAG 2.0 compliant).
- **ListAlpha / Carta:** Full Stack Engineer. Built core features end-to-end in an enterprise relationship intelligence CRM, leading to company acquisition by Carta Inc.
- **Quintegro:** Team Lead. Managed and mentored cross-functional engineering teams of up to 12 developers, driving sprint execution, architecture, and code quality.
- **AI & Practical ML:** Applied AI to business tools and workflow automation long before ChatGPT, including document parsing, RAG architectures, and custom LLM agent systems.

## Primary Tech Stack
- **Languages:** TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, Python, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, Angular, TanStack Query, Zustand, Redux, Vite, Storybook, TailwindCSS.
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, Nest.js, Express.js, GraphQL, REST, tRPC.
- **Databases & Caching:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite, D1, LanceDB (vector database).
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Cloudflare (Workers, Pages, D1), Docker, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
- **Testing:** Vitest, Playwright, Cypress, Jest.
- **AI / LLM Engineering:** Claude Code/Pi Agent workflows, LangChain, RAG pipelines, local LLM tooling (llama.cpp).
